title: The Evolution Trio and the Kenner group
summary: Zanco relays what he knows about the Evolution Trio, a minstrel-style radio group Del Paget once played in, and recalls his Metairie group playing around Kenner.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you know any more about the Evolution Trio?

No, I'm sorry to say. At one time, I think they might have been the staff orchestra of WWL. That's many years ago. And they did somewhat of a minstrel routine with their playing. And people I have talked to over the years, I mean, they seem to think that these guys were the thing at that time. I couldn't give you dates. I don't know dates. I don't know places that they played. But, uh...
What's the lieutenant's name? Do you know his floor name?
Yeah, you said that. I just missed it.

Yeah, I... Then, uh... They used clarinet, drum, and, uh... Banjo. Now, the banjo player lives someplace up in Kenner right now, I believe. I don't know if he plays anymore, but, uh... He lives up in Kenner somewhere.
We found him. Didn't you tell me once you played in Kenner some? With the band?

Well, that was a part of this little group we had out in Metro. Some of the bars were from Kenner, you know, and, uh... After, well, a couple years, you know, you get to meet one of the fellas. Well, let's start playing again, you know. And you might go sit in somebody's house and play a little bit, you know. But, I mean, as far as steady work, we've never ever done anything steady. Just for our own amusement. That's about... That was about the extent of it. See now.
